name: Owen Dreadnought
main_effect:
[Start of Your Main Phase] By returning this Tamer to the bottom of the deck, you may play 1 [Owen Dreadnought] from your hand without paying the cost. Then, if you don't have a Digimon, you may play 1 [Elizamon] from your trash without paying the cost.
[Your Turn] When any of your Digimon digivolve into a [Reptile] or [Dragonkin] Digimon, by suspending this Tamer, that Digimon gets +3000 DP for the turn. Then, it may attack.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
